target.description: Resolve the exact physical witness behind the A02 source label CDLI posting Codex Hammurapi, establish a concise reliable structural profile, and separate object, catalog, inscription, composite, visual, edition, translation, and interpretation layers without acquiring source content.
required_properties: physical stela identity separate from the CDLI posting and composite
reported material, dimensions, dating, find context, custody, language, and script
prologue, legal-section, epilogue, and physical-lacuna structure
official and classical documentation followed by established and fresh controls
acceptable_substitutions: an originating Louvre collection record that resolves SB 8 and the same physical dimensions
a versioned CDLI API response that resolves P249253 as the same physical witness
a current critical edition used only as an editorial control with individual witnesses preserved

channels.source_name: CDLI exact posting, physical artifact, composite, genre, and terms; Louvre collection record
channels.interface_version: current CDLI and Louvre HTML and JSON surfaces checked 2026-08-13
channels.exact_query: Follow the CDLI posting's artifact link, distinguish P464358/Q006387 from physical witness P249253, inspect the P249253 JSON API, corroborate SB 8 against the Louvre collection record and feature, and inspect CDLI terms without retaining payloads.

declared_rights.statement: Posting text is credited to Moudhy al-Rashid; CDLI terms govern provider layers.

results.rationale: The posting is the exact backlog label and a useful concise overview, but its artifact link resolves to a scholarly composite and its generated access-date citation is not treated as an authored publication date.

snapshot.reason: The mutable posting was inspected live; no text or snapshot was retained.

results.title_as_displayed: RIME 4.03.06.add21, ex. 01 (P249253) and Laws of Hammurapi composite (P464358 / Q006387)

declared_rights.statement: CDLI terms distinguish photographs, line art, transliterations, and translations and make reuse layer-specific.

results.rationale: P249253 resolves the exact physical stela and its mutable catalog fields. P464358/Q006387 is recorded only as a linked multi-witness scholarly composite, never as the physical object.

snapshot.reason: HTML and JSON responses were streamed and fingerprinted; no catalog, inscription, composite, image, or drawing was retained.

results.rationale: The holding institution independently resolves SB 8, basalt, dimensions, reported date, Susa discovery, script, language, and custody. Its update warning keeps the record explicitly mutable and bounded.

snapshot.reason: HTML and JSON were streamed and fingerprinted; no collection record, image, or 3D payload was retained.

results.title_as_displayed: CDLI Law collection genre and Terms of Use

declared_rights.statement: CDLI terms distinguish metadata and content-bearing layers and describe conditional academic reuse.

results.rationale: The genre page supports cautious law-collection terminology and the terms support a metadata-only planting while keeping photos, drawings, transliterations, and translations separate.

snapshot.reason: Current documentation and terms were inspected live and not mirrored.

channels.source_name: BnF bibliographic record and Louvre-cited scan route for Scheil 1902
channels.interface_version: current BnF catalogue and Internet Archive item pages checked 2026-08-13
channels.exact_query: Resolve the initial Scheil 1902 publication cited by the Louvre through the BnF catalogue and exact Internet Archive item; retain bibliographic identity only and do not acquire the scan.

results.rationale: The record establishes the classical initial publication route. The scan body was unnecessary for the current metadata profile and was not acquired or treated as automatically redistributable.

snapshot.reason: Bibliographic identity was sufficient; no scan content was needed.

channels.source_name: Established legal-history, law-collection, and royal/scribal tradition controls
channels.interface_version: publisher, university-repository, and DOI records checked 2026-08-13
channels.exact_query: Resolve established top scholarship that controls modern-code projection, comparative law-collection structure, and the separation of royal inscription from scribal transmission; retain bibliographic routes and bounded conclusions only.

results.title_as_displayed: Old Babylonian Period (2003-1595 BC), RIME 4 — 4.03.06.add21, ex. 01
results.rationale: CDLI identifies Frayne 1990 as the primary catalog publication for the physical stela and supplies the exact RIME witness reference.

snapshot.reason: The exact bibliographic reference was sufficient; publication content was not acquired.

results.title_as_displayed: Mesopotamian Legal Traditions and the Laws of Hammurabi
results.rationale: The article is an established control against decontextualizing the monument as a modern statute book. No article content was copied into the source witness.

snapshot.reason: The source was inspected for bounded methodological control and not mirrored.

results.title_as_displayed: Law Collections from Mesopotamia and Asia Minor, Second Edition
results.rationale: This is a standard comparative translation and source-list route. It controls later text work but is not a payload or authority silently inherited by the artifact record.

snapshot.reason: Bibliographic and methodological control was sufficient for this planting.

results.title_as_displayed: The Laws of Hammurabi: At the Confluence of Royal and Scribal Traditions
results.rationale: The book is an established control for separating royal inscription and scribal traditions and for avoiding a single-layer account of authority or function.

snapshot.reason: Publisher metadata and the bounded argument route were sufficient; book content was not acquired.

channels.source_name: Current critical edition, fresh structural note, and latest review lead
channels.interface_version: 2022 critical edition, 2023 open structural note, and 2026 journal metadata checked 2026-08-13
channels.exact_query: Find the freshest sources that materially improve witness separation and the physical stela's structure; reject recency without exact relevance and do not make claims from inaccessible content.

results.title_as_displayed: Der Kodex Ḫammu-rāpi. Textkritische Ausgabe und Übersetzung
results.rationale: This is the strongest current critical route found because it presents individual witnesses and variants synoptically. It is reserved for a later rights-cleared multi-witness laboratory arm.

snapshot.reason: Publisher metadata was sufficient to select a future route; edition content was not acquired.

results.title_as_displayed: NABU 2023/62 — structural note on the Hammurabi stela
results.rationale: The note supplies the most useful concise current structural map found: prologue, start of section 1, seven-column lacuna, reverse resumption, end of section 282, and epilogue columns. The PDF was read remotely and not downloaded.

snapshot.reason: Only bounded structural findings and bibliographic identity were retained; the PDF was not mirrored.

results.title_as_displayed: On Researching and Teaching Mesopotamian Law

declared_rights.statement: Publisher page exposes restrictive rights and text-and-data-mining terms.

results.rationale: This is the newest directly relevant lead, but only metadata was accessible. It contributes no substantive claim and is unnecessary for the narrow artifact profile; request access later only if the full argument becomes necessary.

snapshot.reason: No claim was made from inaccessible content and no performative access request was created.

channel_comparison.notes: Best exact physical identity and current operational route. The CDLI posting, provider record, composite, and Louvre notice remain separate mutable sources.
Strong initial-publication lineage; the scan body was not required, acquired, or presumed reusable.
Strong controls against modern-code projection and layer collapse; most content remains publisher- or edition-governed.
Oelsner and Zhiltsova materially improve witness and structure control. The newer 2026 lead was deferred because inaccessible metadata cannot support substantive claims.
